summary.one_liner: Tabby is a self-hosted AI coding assistant that serves as an open-source, on-premises alternative to GitHub Copilot.
summary.what_it_does: Tabby runs as a self-contained server with no DBMS or cloud service required. It exposes an OpenAPI interface so it can be integrated with existing infrastructure such as cloud IDEs. The README says it supports consumer-grade GPUs. The quickstart runs a Docker container that serves a code completion model (StarCoder-1B) and a chat model (Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct) on CUDA. The README also describes an Answer Engine for team knowledge, IDE/editor extensions (VSCode, and JetBrains and Vim are mentioned in the news), repo-level context for completion, and integrations with GitLab and GitHub. The news section mentions indexing GitLab Merge Requests and adding custom documentation via REST APIs.
use_cases: self-hosted code completion for a development team
AI chat about internal engineering docs and code
running a coding assistant on consumer GPUs
integrating AI code suggestions into an IDE or cloud IDE
how_to_run: docker run -it --gpus all -p 8080:8080 -v $HOME/.tabby:/data tabbyml/tabby serve --model StarCoder-1B --device cuda --chat-model Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct
Install protobuf (brew install protobuf on macOS; apt install protobuf-compiler libopenblas-dev on Ubuntu/Debian)
Install optional tools: apt install make sqlite3 graphviz
notable: Self-contained: no database server or cloud service needed
OpenAPI interface for integration with existing tools
Answer Engine turns team knowledge and chat into shareable pages
Repo-level and local-snippet context used for code completion
caveats: The README's Community/Star History sections do not describe a license; the GitHub metadata lists NOASSERTION, so license terms need checking in the repository
Build from source requires Rust, protobuf, and submodules; the README gives no platform matrix beyond macOS and Ubuntu/Debian package commands
Some features (such as the Agent preview and Pochi task integration) are described as preview or waitlist items
keywords: share code assistant on team server
